name: Word
overview: Scripture reveals the profound significance of the Word, identifying it both as God's powerful and unfailing communication and as a title for Jesus Christ, who is the Word made flesh. God's Word is described as a guiding light and a source of life that will never pass away, accomplishing His purposes without fail. Believers are called to trust and live by every word from God's mouth, recognizing the authority and faithfulness embodied in Christ, the eternal Word who dwelt among us full of grace and truth.
